## Natural history notes

A medium-sized corsair assassin bug characterized by its slender dark body, long legs, narrow head, and piercing beak used to subdue prey. In Florida, it is found in warm open or semi-open habitats such as fields, pine flatwoods, roadsides, forest edges, sandy areas, and around lights where nocturnal insects are attracted. It is a predatory true bug, feeding on other insects and arthropods by stabbing prey with its beak and injecting digestive saliva; like other assassin bugs, it should not be handled because it can deliver a painful defensive bite.
